material_recommendations: Proceed conditionally with a pilot-first gate.
Use Microsoft Teams Webinars as default delivery if M365 is active.
Start at lean MVP cost tier and graduate only after two successful sessions.
Require an existing engaged author-audience email list of at least 500 subscribers or spend 90 days building the list first.
Measure registration rate, attendance rate, Q&A engagement, and post-event conversion before committing to quarterly cadence.

Undefined revenue model makes free webinars expensive audience-building with no conversion path.
Quarterly cadence hides substantial production load of roughly 40-60 hours per session.
Weak differentiation would place JM1 against crowded author-education incumbents.
Launching before brand/message clarity may lock in premature positioning.
strategic_insights: Author-as-business-operator is the differentiating lane, not writing craft education.
The webinar can demonstrate JM1's author-led enterprise model while generating leads.
A rotating co-brand model can keep the JM1 umbrella coherent while varying topics.
Microsoft-first is viable for delivery, but branded registration, nurture, replay monetization, SEO, and affiliate tracking may need targeted additions.
